status: SOURCE CARTILAGE SPHERE ESTIMATES; NOT VERIFIED ANATOMICAL JOINT CENTRES
limitations: Source-labelled femoral-head and acetabular cartilage are real downloaded models, but sphere centres are numerical estimates, not supplied landmarks.
Both inner/outer and rim surfaces contribute. Fitting a sphere does not identify a biological rotation axis or ensure source/HRA joint correspondence.
These source surfaces are not added to the runtime atlas.
